zoe: quick sync: I uploaded candidate v2.4-int4-lite to staging shadow. need a tight canary with clear auto-fallback rules.
omar: saw offline eval: generative-fidelity dip ~0.6 pts on long-doc slice, latency +12ms p95, cost -18% token.
reena: propose rollout: 1% 20m -> 4% 90m -> 15% 6h. add 12h quiet-shadow on long-doc after 4% step.
zoe: rollback triggers I'm leaning to: (1) quality composite: fidelity_drop >= 0.6 AND halluc_inc >= 0.3 over 20m AND samples>=150 => auto-fallback, (2) perf: p95_delta >= 70ms over 10m => route to safe-tier, (3) single high-signal (contradiction_inc >=0.5) => page and hold.
omar: add stats: require bootstrap_pval < 0.1 for auto-fallback to act. single-signal still pages.
reena: canary-bot: assemble config and start when patch merged. tag rollout_id=v24-lite-175123.
canary-bot: queued deploy: model=v2.4-int4-lite env=staging mode=canary_run start=1751240000 run_id=canary-175123.
zoe: also collect rerank_prec@1 for short prompts and mean_embed_cosine. post the 20m smoke summary here (p95, fidelity_delta, hall_rate, sample_count). keep it terse.
omar: fyi i'll add a minor backoff: if p95 spike >120ms for any 5m window, drop to 0% immediately and page.
reena: noted. will post first-check after 20m.
